source.scope: Full source suite after integration of Docker provisioning, service port/fence and prerequisite SDK facade; network denied in source fixtures

integration.scope: Real synthetic Linux subprocess/loopback/SQLite; shared public SDK/router/native lifecycle; reviewed backup/uninstall stopped before effects when a service receipt appears

limits: Modeled Docker daemon and modeled systemd manager are source coverage, not installed-platform acceptance
Systemd runner additionally tested with real private D-Bus and owned child processes; no live systemd service registration
Prerequisite OS packages were not installed; safe synthetic subprocess and injected adapters only
No new frozen installer or visual browser acceptance in CP-008; JS behavior contract ran in Node
No real reboot, relogin, power loss or production product data
Subtests and separate focused scopes are not added to the full-test count

final_test_only_changes.description: Linux-only service modules skip before POSIX imports/decorators on other OS; Windows symlink fixture skips only when OS denies link creation
